proof.text: Because $\mu$ is surjective (every $c\in C$ is the image of $c\otimes1$) and flat by Step 1, [lem-trf-flat-epimorphism-derived-self-tensor] identifies $C\otimes_{C\otimes_R C}^{\mathbf L}C$ with $C[0]$. Applying [lem-trf-derived-diagonal-cotangent-vanishing] to $C\otimes_R C\to C$ therefore gives $L_{C/(C\otimes_R C)}=0$.

Flatness of $C$ over $R$ makes $\operatorname{Tor}^R_i(C,C)=0$ for every $i>0$. Together with the vanishing of $L_{C/(C\otimes_R C)}$ from Step 2, [lem-trf-cotangent-bootstrap] applies and yields $L_{C/R}=0$. The cohomology formulation follows from the definition of the derived category.

title: Vanishing of the full cotangent complex for etale ring maps
statement: Let $R\to C$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings that is etale: it is finitely presented as an algebra [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra] and for every $R$-algebra $D$ and square-zero ideal $J\subseteq D$, reduction gives a bijection $\operatorname{Hom}_{R\text{-alg}}(C,D)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{R\text{-alg}}(C,D/J)$. Then its standard cotangent complex [lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence] is zero in $D(C)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]; equivalently $H^i(L_{C/R})=0$ for every integer $i$.
